title: SBA 7(a) Charge-Off Rates 1992-2026
description:
Charge-off rates for the US Small Business Administration 7(a) loan programme, computed from the full public record released under FOIA, 1992 to 2026.

Three aggregate CSVs: charge-off rates by state, by industry, and by franchise.

Note on scope: the by-industry file contains the top 20 industries by resolved loan volume, not every industry above a volume threshold. Published by Finance Clearly, a publication of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd.
